confidence_policy: CONFIRMED denotes semantic correspondence reviewed against pinned source and exact instructions/relations, not recovered original symbols or whole-source equivalence. Prior community sources reused as fixture leads; no community-based promotions.
scope: Direct invocation callers of processor tick/enqueue plus IValue default catch boundary; all955class files scanned, not reflection/runtime.
finding: Two CustomEntity task invocations pass null callbacks, but their generated functional objects implement evalUnsafe and inherit IValue default eval. Default eval catches Throwable from evalUnsafe, logs and returns null. Ordinary expression exceptions therefore do NOT establish the processor null-callback failure path; logger/setter/override failures remain separate unverified possibilities. Immediate tick caller has no handlers; higher callers not closed.
